title: OmniShell
subtitle: Declarative Terminal Orchestration, Runtimes & Local AI Hub
summary: Declarative modern terminal ecosystem unifying GNU Stow, Docker/DevContainers, and local AI agents (DeepSeek, Qwen, and Phonon TTS) with Zero-Leak security policies.
overview: OmniShell is an agnostic, declarative ecosystem for modern terminal workflows (Zsh and Warp Terminal). It functions as a local orchestration layer unifying backend runtimes (PHP/Laravel, Python, Java), containerized infrastructure (Docker/DevContainers), and local generative AI capabilities (RAG with DeepSeek-R1, code generation with Qwen2.5-Coder, and voice synthesis via Phonon TTS) with atomic package management powered by GNU Stow.
roleDescription: Systems Architect, DevOps & Local AI Engineer.
responsibilities: Designed idempotent declarative architecture with GNU Stow and automated bootstrap installation scripts.
Orchestrated local LLM runtimes (Qwen2.5 and DeepSeek-R1) via Ollama and integrated Phonon TTS voice synthesis.
Built omni and omni-rag CLI tools for contextual command RAG and interactive YAML workflows.
Implemented Zero-Leak secret policies with lazy-loaded 1Password CLI and DevContainer environment isolation.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Balancing deep terminal customization with portability and high-speed startup without bloated dotfiles frameworks.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Surgically used GNU Stow for modular, atomic symlink trees linked cleanly to the $HOME directory.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Command-line LLM prompts often introduced latency and hallucinated generic, incompatible commands.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Built the omni ask engine injecting local workflow and alias contexts, ensuring recommendations match existing environment tools.
